description: This file defines the RenderCacheInterface interface for caching rendered arrays in Drupal's rendering system.

methods.name: getCacheableRenderArray
methods.description: Returns a cacheable array for a given render array and its output.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a pre-rendered cached element, or FALSE if not available.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Caches the rendered output of a renderable array.
